observation_unit: corpus token of an English dative realization
annotation_process: corpus examples from Switchboard and the Wall Street Journal portion of the Penn Treebank, with variables documented by Bresnan et al. (2007) and languageR 1.5.0
sampling_and_dependence: tokens repeat verbs; Switchboard tokens repeat speakers; written-source speaker identifiers are structurally absent
original_use: multivariable prediction of NP versus PP recipient realization from lexical, semantic, discourse, and structural predictors
teaching_simplification: value-preserving column renaming; the early missing-data use isolates source-defined speaker-ID absence without treating it as a stochastic missingness process
